Conditions here usually favor the seamers early on, promising an exciting contest between bat and ball. With New Zealand aiming to start their WTC journey with a win and the West Indies looking to prove their resilience away from home, the stage is perfectly set. Sit back and enjoy as Test cricket returns to the beautiful Hagley Oval. Toss and team news in a bit...

For the visitors, the challenge is significant as they are missing their premier fast bowlers, Alzarri and Shamar Joseph. They will rely heavily on the returning veteran Kemar Roach and the in-form Jayden Seales to exploit the swinging conditions. Their batting lineup, featuring Shai Hope and John Campbell who recently scored centuries in India, must show grit and patience to handle the moving ball against the Kiwi pacers.

The Blackcaps have received a major boost with the return of captain Tom Latham, the prolific Kane Williamson, and the consistent Daryl Mitchell to the squad. While injuries have ruled out a few key bowlers like Kyle Jamieson, the attack remains dangerous with Matt Henry leading the line alongside fresh talents like Nathan Smith and local favorite Zak Foulkes. The management faces a few tough selection calls, particularly choosing between Devon Conway and Will Young at the top of the order.

Welcome to Hagley Oval in Christchurch for the opening match of this three-Test series! New Zealand is finally kicking off their World Test Championship 2025-27 campaign, looking to translate their recent white-ball success against England and the Windies into the longest format. On the other hand, the West Indies have had a challenging few months with tough losses in Australia and India, but they will be eager to adapt to these conditions and put up a strong fight in this fresh cycle.
